packet.headline_seed: Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion
packet.description_seed: Article URL: https://consumerrights.wiki/w/Microsoft_Office_2019_and_2021_for_Mac_view-only_conversion_(2026) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48341578 Points: 738 # Comments: 246

what: Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion

clean_source_blocks.text: Article URL: https://consumerrights.wiki/w/Microsoft_Office_2019_and_2021_for_Mac_view-only_conversion_(2026) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48341578 Points: 738 # Comments: 246

Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion (2026) is a scheduled remote degradation of perpetually-licensed Microsoft Office software for macOS and iOS, set for July 13, 2026 when a license-validation certificate used by the Office apps expires.[1] After Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support in October 2023, Microsoft assured customers their installed apps would "continue to function."[2] The July 13, 2026 conversion instead drops the apps into a Microsoft-defined "reduced functionality mode," in which files can be opened and viewed but not edited or saved.[1][3] By May 30, 2026, the original 2023 end-of-support page had been re-dated and rewritten on Microsoft's site; the "continue to function" clause was removed.[4][2]

Office 2021 for Mac became generally available on October 5, 2021 under the same one-time-purchase model & is scheduled to reach end of support on October 13, 2026 per the Microsoft Lifecycle Policy.[7] Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support on October 10, 2023.[3] The June 3, 2023 snapshot of Microsoft's end-of-support page contained this passage: Support for Office 2019 for Mac will end on October 10, 2023. Rest assured that all your Office 2019 apps will continue to function—they won't disappear from your Mac, nor will you lose any data. However, you could expose yourself to serious and potentially harmful security risks.[2] By May 30, 2026, the same URL carried a new publication date of May 15th, 2026 and a shorter passage:

In October, Microsoft officially ended support for Office 2019 for Mac, a standalone version of its ubiquitous productivity suite. While support was no longer provided, users could still use the software. Unfortunately, that's about to change no matter how old your hardware is, and regardless of what version of Apple's OSes you're running. Starting July 13, 2026, Microsoft will disable almost all functionality for Microsoft Office users on macOS 11 Big Sur. It will also put Office 2019 into read-only mode for all users, regardless of OS. It's also bricking its mobile apps on devices running iPadOS 16 and iOS 16 or earlier. Before you start to panic, don't worry; you will still be able to access all of your Microsoft Office files.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: Hacker News Best]
Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion (2026) is a scheduled remote degradation of perpetually-licensed Microsoft Office software for macOS and iOS, set for July 13, 2026 when a license-validation certificate used by the Office apps expires.[1] After Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support in October 2023, Microsoft assured customers their installed apps would "continue to function."[2] The July 13, 2026 conversion instead drops the apps into a Microsoft-defined "reduced functionality mode," in which files can be opened and viewed but not edited or saved.[1][3] By May 30, 2026, the original 2023 end-of-support page had been re-dated and rewritten on Microsoft's site; the "continue to function" clause was removed.[4][2]

Microsoft announced general availability of Office 2019 for Windows and Mac on September 24, 2018. In the launch blog post, Microsoft's Jared Spataro wrote that "Office 2019 is a one-time release and won't receive future feature updates," positioning the product as the on-premises alternative to the Office 365 subscription.[5] Contemporary Microsoft Store pages marketed Office Home & Student 2019 as a "One-time purchase for 1 PC or Mac" at $149.99, with copy that explicitly contrasted the perpetual product against the Office 365 subscription model: "One-time purchases don't have an upgrade option, which means if you plan to upgrade to the next major release, you'll have to buy it at full price."[6]

Office 2021 for Mac became generally available on October 5, 2021 under the same one-time-purchase model & is scheduled to reach end of support on October 13, 2026 per the Microsoft Lifecycle Policy.[7]

Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support on October 10, 2023.[3]

The June 3, 2023 snapshot of Microsoft's end-of-support page contained this passage:

Support for Office 2019 for Mac will end on October 10, 2023. Rest assured that all your Office 2019 apps will continue to function—they won't disappear from your Mac, nor will you lose any data. However, you could expose yourself to serious and potentially harmful security risks.[2]

By May 30, 2026, the same URL carried a new publication date of May 15th, 2026 and a shorter passage:

Support for Office 2019 for Mac ended on October 10, 2023. Rest assured that all your Office 2019 apps won't lose any data. Your data can be accessed on any supported Microsoft 365 or Office product. However, you could expose yourself to serious and potentially harmful security risks.[4]



---

[Lähde: AppleInsider]
In October, Microsoft officially ended support for Office 2019 for Mac, a standalone version of its ubiquitous productivity suite. While support was no longer provided, users could still use the software.

Unfortunately, that's about to change no matter how old your hardware is, and regardless of what version of Apple's OSes you're running.

Starting July 13, 2026, Microsoft will disable almost all functionality for Microsoft Office users on macOS 11 Big Sur. It will also put Office 2019 into read-only mode for all users, regardless of OS.

It's also bricking its mobile apps on devices running iPadOS 16 and iOS 16 or earlier.

Before you start to panic, don't worry; you will still be able to access all of your Microsoft Office files.

What you won't be able to do, however, is edit them, save them, or create any new files. Instead, you'll be relegated to what Microsoft charitably calls "reduced functionality mode."

It really should be called "give us more money mode."

In this mode, you can view and print files, but you cannot edit, save, or create new files. At all. If you want to interact with your files in any meaningful way, you have a couple of different options.

If you're on macOS 11 or earlier, you'll need to upgrade to macOS 12 Monterey, or later to continue using Microsoft Office 365 or Office 2021. Doing so is relatively easy, assuming your Mac supports it.

For mobile users, updating your iPad or iPhone is done by following the steps below.

If your Mac or mobile device of choice doesn't support the minimum required operating system, you're not entirely out of options, either.

If your Mac doesn't support macOS 12 or newer, you can purchase a Microsoft 365 subscription and use Microsoft 365 from your preferred browser.

This may not be the most convenient way to access your files long term, but it will allow you to edit and save them.

Important: You'll notice we didn't mention Office 2024, and for good reason. Office 2024 requires macOS 14, that's macOS Sonoma, so those users are already in the clear.

While Microsoft's support documentation is not entirely clear, it seems as though the company is effectively bricking Office 2019 for all macOS users, regardless of operating system.

This means that even if you're running macOS 26, the most recent iteration of Apple's operating system, you will lose most functionality within Office 2019. This isn't terribly ideal, especially since many online vendors are still actively selling Office 2019 to us

payload.title: Microsoftin vanhat Office-versiot Macilla siirtymässä katselutilaan heinäkuussa 2026
payload.summary: Microsoft Office 2019 for Macin ja osin vanhojen Apple-laitteiden Office-sovellusten toiminnallisuus on muuttumassa heinäkuussa 2026. Käyttäjät voivat edelleen avata tiedostoja, mutta muokkaaminen ja tallentaminen voivat estyä.
payload.content:
Microsoftin Office 2019 for Mac on lähteiden mukaan siirtymässä 13. heinäkuuta 2026 rajoitetun toiminnallisuuden tilaan, jossa tiedostoja voi avata ja katsella mutta ei muokata tai tallentaa. Muutos koskee pysyvällä kertamaksulisenssillä hankittua ohjelmistoa, jonka varsinainen tuki päättyi jo lokakuussa 2023.

## Muutos koskee vanhoja Mac- ja mobiiliversioita

Tietojen mukaan muutos liittyy Office-sovellusten käyttämään lisenssinvarmennussertifikaattiin, jonka on määrä vanhentua 13. heinäkuuta 2026. Tämän jälkeen Office 2019 for Mac asetetaan Microsoftin määrittelemään rajoitettuun tilaan. Käytännössä käyttäjä voi avata olemassa olevia Word-, Excel- ja PowerPoint-tiedostoja, mutta niiden muokkaaminen ja tallentaminen eivät enää onnistu kyseisillä sovelluksilla.

AppleInsiderin mukaan Microsoft aikoo samalla poistaa lähes kaiken toiminnallisuuden Office-käyttäjiltä, joiden Macissa on macOS 11 Big Sur. Lisäksi Office 2019 siirtyy kirjoituksen mukaan vain luku -tilaan kaikilla käyttäjillä käyttöjärjestelmäversiosta riippumatta. Myös iPadOS 16:lla ja iOS 16:lla tai niitä vanhemmilla versioilla toimivat Office-mobiilisovellukset menettävät toiminnallisuuttaan.

Tiedostojen itsensä ei kerrota katoavan. Keskeinen vaikutus on se, että vanhoilla Office-sovelluksilla ei voi enää jatkaa asiakirjojen normaalia käsittelyä, jos sovellus siirtyy rajoitettuun tilaan.

## Aiempi lupaus herättää huomiota

Office 2019 for Macin tuki päättyi 10. lokakuuta 2023. Tuolloin Microsoftin tukisivun arkistoidun version mukaan asennetut Office 2019 -sovellukset jatkaisivat toimintaansa, eivät katoaisi Macilta eikä käyttäjä menettäisi tietojaan, vaikka tietoturvariskit kasvaisivat tuen päätyttyä.

Lähdeaineiston mukaan samaa Microsoftin sivua oli 30. toukokuuta 2026 mennessä muutettu: julkaisupäiväksi oli merkitty 15. toukokuuta 2026, ja aiempi kohta sovellusten toiminnan jatkumisesta oli poistettu. Tämä on nostanut esiin kysymyksen siitä, mitä pysyvällä lisenssillä ostetulta ohjelmistolta voi odottaa tuen päättymisen jälkeen.

Office 2021 for Mac julkaistiin yleisesti 5. lokakuuta 2021 samaan kertamaksumalliin, ja sen tuen on määrä päättyä Microsoftin elinkaarikäytännön mukaan 13. lokakuuta 2026. Lähdeaineiston perusteella heinäkuun 2026 muutos kohdistuu erityisesti vanhoihin Mac- ja mobiiliympäristöihin sekä Office 2019 for Maciin.
summary_bullets: Office 2019 for Macin kerrotaan siirtyvän rajoitettuun katselutilaan 13. heinäkuuta 2026.
Tiedostoja voi edelleen avata, mutta muokkaaminen ja tallentaminen voivat estyä vanhoilla sovelluksilla.
Muutos liittyy lähteiden mukaan lisenssinvarmennussertifikaatin vanhenemiseen ja koskee myös vanhoja Apple-käyttöjärjestelmiä.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu annettuun lähdepakettiin. Keskeiset päivämäärät ja vaikutukset on rajattu lähteissä mainittuihin tietoihin, eikä Microsoftin kantaa ole lisätty lähdepaketin ulkopuolelta.

Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion (2026) is a scheduled remote degradation of perpetually-licensed Microsoft Office software for macOS and iOS, set for July 13, 2026 when a license-validation certificate used by the Office apps expires.[1] After Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support in October 2023, Microsoft assured customers their installed apps would "continue to function."[2] The July 13, 2026 conversion instead drops the apps into a Microsoft-defined "reduced functionality mode," in which files can be opened and viewed but not edited or saved.[1][3] By May 30, 2026, the original 2023 end-of-support page had been re-dated and rewritten on Microsoft's site; the "continue to function" clause was removed.[4][2]

Office 2021 for Mac became generally available on October 5, 2021 under the same one-time-purchase model & is scheduled to reach end of support on October 13, 2026 per the Microsoft Lifecycle Policy.[7] Office 2019 for Mac reached end of support on October 10, 2023.[3] The June 3, 2023 snapshot of Microsoft's end-of-support page contained this passage: Support for Office 2019 for Mac will end on October 10, 2023. Rest assured that all your Office 2019 apps will continue to function—they won't disappear from your Mac, nor will you lose any data. However, you could expose yourself to serious and potentially harmful security risks.[2] By May 30, 2026, the same URL carried a new publication date of May 15th, 2026 and a shorter passage:

In October, Microsoft officially ended support for Office 2019 for Mac, a standalone version of its ubiquitous productivity suite. While support was no longer provided, users could still use the software. Unfortunately, that's about to change no matter how old your hardware is, and regardless of what version of Apple's OSes you're running. Starting July 13, 2026, Microsoft will disable almost all functionality for Microsoft Office users on macOS 11 Big Sur. It will also put Office 2019 into read-only mode for all users, regardless of OS. It's also bricking its mobile apps on devices running iPadOS 16 and iOS 16 or earlier. Before you start to panic, don't worry; you will still be able to access all of your Microsoft Office files.
